item.title: Anush Agarwalla Makes Impressive International Debut At Belgium Dressage Events
item.description: The Belgium Dressage Events: Indian equestrian Anush Agarwalla made an impressive international debut at the prestigious Belgium Dressage Events with Floriana, delivering composed and competitive performances as he began his qualification journey toward the upcoming Asian Games.

item.title: India's Nitin Menon Among Elite Panel Of Match Officials For ICC T20 WC Semifinals
item.description: ICC T20 WC: India's Nitin Menon is among the elite panel of match officials named for the ICC Men's T20 World Cup semifinals scheduled on March 4 and 5.

item.title: Some Contingents May Get Delayed For Paralympic Winter Games, IPC Monitoring Crisis In Middle East
item.description: The International Paralympic Committee: With four days to go for the opening ceremony of the 2026 Paralympic Winter Games in Milano Cortina, Italy, the conflict in the Middle East is threatening to disrupt the quadrennial event because of its impact on air travel through the region, as many contingents are yet to reach Europe.

item.title: T20 WC: 'Use Two Overs Of Bumrah In Powerplay To Break England's Back', Gavaskar's Advise For India Ahead Of SF
item.description: DP World Celebrity Golf Event: Legendary opener Sunil Gavaskar has advised India to use Jasprit Bumrah for bowling two overs in the powerplay of the Men’s T20 World Cup semi-final against England at the Wankhede Stadium on Thursday, noting that early breakthroughs from the fast-bowling spearhead could derail the opposition before finding their rhythm.

item.title: Copa Del Rey: Barcelona Look For A Miracle As Atletico Aim To Defend 4-goal Lead In Camp Nou
item.description: Camp Nou: FC Barcelona face a massive task on Tuesday when they face Atletico Madrid in the second leg of the Copa del Rey semifinal, looking to overhaul a 4-0 deficit from the first leg.

item.title: Gavaskar To Host Celebrity Golf Event In Mumbai To Supports Former Players Facing Financial and Medical Challenges
item.description: Bombay Presidency Golf Club: Former India captain and legendary batter Sunil Gavaskar will host a star-studded charity golf event in Mumbai this week to raise awareness for his CHAMPS Foundation, which supports former India players facing financial and medical challenges.

item.title: Mbappe Doubtful For UCL Clash Against Man City Due To Knee Injury
item.description: UEFA Champions League: Real Madrid published a medical report on striker Kylian Mbappe, confirming the French international has suffered a left knee sprain.

item.title: 'It's Time To Rest and Reset': Sindhu Safely Returns Home After Being Stranded In Dubai For 3 Days
item.description: ICC T20 World Cup: Indian badminton ace PV Sindhu has returned home safely after being stuck in Dubai for three days after flight operations were suspended owing to escalating tensions in West Asia.

item.title: Alcaraz Gets Tricky Draw In Indian Wells With Djokovic In His Half
item.description: Indian Wells Open: Top seed Carlos Alcaraz will open the Indian Wells Open, season's first ATP Masters 1000 event, against former World No. 3 Grigor Dimitrov or Terence Atmane, with five-time champion Novak Djokovic also looming in his half of the draw.

item.title: 'The Most Heart-warming Story Of The Week': Shastri Hails J&K;'s Fairytale Ranji Triumph
item.description: T20 World Cup: Former Indian cricketer and coach Ravi Shastri congratulated the Jammu & Kashmir team for winning their maiden Ranji Trophy title, describing the historic triumph as a shining example of the domestic tournament providing some fairy tale stories which will be remembered for a very long time.
